components.name: GTK3 / Adwaita
components.focus: Review Adwaita widget selectors, states and resource changes.
components.tests: tests/test_runtime.py, tests/test_borders.py and GTK3 accent/native consumers.

components.name: GTK / Default (current and future majors)
components.focus: Review default style imports, widget nodes and public CSS changes. A new major needs a separate compatibility decision.
components.tests: tests/test_runtime.py, tests/border_native.py and tests/accent_native.py gtk on the new toolkit.

components.name: libadwaita
components.focus: Review named colors, CSS variables, light/dark derivation and new widget classes.
components.tests: Modern and legacy overrides; tests/test_runtime.py and all-accent native GTK checks.

components.name: GNOME desktop release
components.focus: Review release NEWS and component versions; this does not establish a complete desktop/login-session test.
components.tests: Targeted Shell/toolkit checks and a real desktop smoke test when available.

components.name: GNOME Shell (current and future majors)
components.focus: Review Shell Sass, assets and menu/control structure. New majors remain unsupported until tested; do not overwrite pinned sources automatically.
components.tests: tests/gnome-shell native pointer/Wayland fixtures and all-accent Shell checks.

components.name: GNOME Shell 46 maintenance
components.focus: Review maintenance changes to the supported Shell 46 baseline.
components.tests: GNOME Shell 46 build/source and native pointer/accent tests.

components.name: Cinnamon
components.focus: Review shell selectors, menu/calendar/taskbar states and Settings preview lookup.

components.name: Muffin
components.focus: Review decoration/theme-loader changes and window states.
components.tests: Native Metacity/Muffin frame rendering and window-state checks.

components.name: Xfce panel
components.focus: Review GTK panel selectors and active/hover states.
components.tests: Real panel, menu and task-button tests; GTK parsing and accent checks.

components.name: Xfwm4 integration
components.focus: Review integration boundaries. This repository does not supply Xfwm4 decorations.
components.tests: Xfce GTK/panel integration smoke test; do not claim new decoration support.

components.name: MATE desktop
components.focus: Review appearance/schema changes. The baseline records the reviewed stable series, not a complete MATE login-session certification.
components.tests: MATE appearance preference checks and GTK application smoke tests.

components.name: Marco
components.focus: Review Metacity decoration parsing, drawing and window states.
components.tests: Native frame and Marco window-state tests.

components.name: Budgie
components.focus: Review GTK integration and panel/Raven behavior. No dedicated Budgie shell stylesheet is supplied.
components.tests: Appearance preference checks and panel/Raven smoke tests.

components.name: Adwaita Icon Theme (folder source and fallback)
components.focus: Review full-color folder SVGs, new/renamed folder aliases, index.theme inheritance, symbolic lookup and license notices. Application-icon-only changes may not need a theme update. Do not change artwork or inheritance automatically.
components.tests: tools/generate_icons.py --check, tests/test_icons.py, all-accent native GTK/Qt icon lookup/render tests and representative file-manager checks.

components.name: Nemo (application-specific GTK integration)
components.focus: Review desktop/icon-container rename entries, selection/context menus and CSS-node/style-class changes used by our Nemo-specific rules. Unrelated features do not imply a theme change.
components.tests: GTK3 parsing, Nemo inline-rename regression and tests/filemanager_icons.py across accents; confirm real selection/context-menu behavior.
